title: NFTTickets
tagline: We are working on a ticket service that allow anyone to create a batch of tokens that act as tickets for a given event.
description: The project aims to create a framework for users of the dapp to being able to create tickets that work as NFT. Users might be able to retrieve from the app the information from the tickets. We would like to pursue more into building a real protocol to issue tokens as tickets for the public general.
how_its_made: We worked with the EIP1155 Multitoken standard to comply with the creation of multiple tokens at one. We wanted to provide a seamless experience for the user. For that reason, we used Web3Auth as a sponsor to use their code and improve our MVP the best possible way. We are not yet using Moralis but is a work in progress.
